versions.changelog:
Initial release of CashClaw Lead Generator.

- Systematically generates qualified B2B lead lists with contact info and qualification scores.
- Supports custom Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) definition for precise targeting.
- Utilizes multi-channel research (websites, LinkedIn, directories, job boards, etc.).
- Comprehensive lead data fields and scoring rubric (1–10) included.
- Delivers leads in JSON, CSV, and Markdown summary formats.
- Strict compliance with ethical guidelines (data privacy, GDPR/CAN-SPAM, no scraping where not permitted).
- Quality standards ensure verified, non-duplicate, high-scoring leads.
